claims.statement: A single shared policy file test-utils/network-policy.json (schema epic128-test-network-policy/v1) defines the test network allowlist (loopback plus docker service hosts, http/https/ws/wss, no Unix sockets) and test-utils/outbound-network-policy.ts enforces it via assertAllowedTestUrl/assertAllowedSocketHost, throwing ERR_TEST_NETWORK_DENIED on violations; both Vitest and Playwright guards read the same file.

The full Vitest suite floor was raised after Story 173.9 closed (sprint-status.yaml, 2026-08-30): a full `npm test -- --run` run must keep ≥ 19,733 tests passing across ≥ 1,249 test files with 0 failed; this is a floor, not a substitute for fresh per-story validation.

Story 173.2 delivered two dedicated backfill-admin e2e specs under e2e/settings/: backfill-admin.spec.ts pins the deterministic Owner shell at /settings/backfill against a stubbed `**/v1/admin/backfill/status` (per-cabinet dual-pipeline reports/analytics status, progress with ETA, lastError, mutating-guarded interactions), and backfill-a11y.spec.ts pins WCAG 2.1 AA axe scans over a dense eight-cabinet mixed-status fixture (including a long RU cabinet name proving wrap without horizontal overflow), keyboard/dialog focus, and 320–1440px layout cases using the Story 162.8 bounded-settle terminal pattern.

Stories 173.8/173.9 restored dedicated shipments e2e packages under e2e/shipments/: shipments-list.spec.ts drives /shipments via a switchable scenario fixture (default/empty/error/gated-pending) covering status filtering, pagination, the create-shipment dialog, and empty/error states; shipments-detail.spec.ts stubs `**/v1/shipments/story-173-9-detail` to cover the header, pallet accordion, box-line allocation table (calculated vs pending lines), draft-vs-confirmed actions, and an axe scan. Sibling specs cover shipments a11y/lifecycle, and e2e/supplies/ mirrors the same list/detail/lifecycle/a11y shape.

Telegram notification e2e coverage lives only in e2e/telegram-notifications.spec.ts (binding status with bound/telegram_user_id/binding_expires_at, preferences, quiet hours, and success/failure/pending mutation modes via route stubs with axe scans); the former duplicate at tests/e2e/telegram-notifications.spec.ts is absent from the current tree, while src/test/playwright-static-boundary.ts still scans the `tests/e2e/` path prefix defensively.

e2e/settings-pages.spec.ts pins the shared settings shell across cabinet/tariffs/notifications/tax/expenses/backfill routes: the exact seven-item ordered navigation (Обзор, Кабинет, Уведомления, Налоги, Тарифы, Расходы, Импорт) with exactly one visible `aria-current="page"` per route, compact-Sheet keyboard focus containment, light/dark theming via localStorage.theme with reload, horizontal-overflow checks, and zero-violation per-page axe scans (wcag2a/wcag2aa/wcag22aa).

Current local validation is the README.md Local validation command list (type-check, lint, `npm test -- --run`, test:privacy, test:coverage, check:privacy, format:check, build) plus the active story plan; there is no mandatory CI merge gate, and development/validation are local-only (frontend :3100, backend :3000). scripts/story-128-10/ is immutable historical, branch-bound Story 128.10 evidence tied to the former feat/epic-128-10-frontend-verification-foundation branch and must not be treated as a current validation entry point.

The openwiki-update.yml workflow protects a generated/protected boundary: after generation it restores .github/workflows/openwiki-update.yml, every AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md to their HEAD versions; it stages only `git add -A -- openwiki/ ':(top,exclude)openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md'` and refuses to commit anything staged outside openwiki/, any unexpected unstaged/untracked/ignored file; checkout uses persist-credentials: false.

Scheduled openwiki runs on main commit, then create and push a unique automation branch `automation/openwiki-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}` (attempt included so failed-publication reruns use a fresh branch) via a temporary x-access-token remote URL restored through an EXIT trap, and open a PR against main via the GitHub REST API with curl — no gh CLI, no force-push, no direct push to main, no auto-merge. Manual dispatches must target a non-main branch ref and push the generated commit back to that same branch; dispatch on main is rejected before checkout.
